meta.name: add-wechat
meta.description: Add WeChat (personal) channel integration via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. Uses long-polling and QR scan — no webhook, no ToS risk, no paid token.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 集成微信个人号消息收发，无需付费Token
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将微信个人号接入自动化流程
copy.tagline_en: Integrate WeChat personal account messaging without paid tokens
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to connect WeChat personal account to automation workflows

howto.what: 装上后，NanoClaw 能用你的个人微信号收/发微信消息：私聊或群聊会进入绑定的 agent 组，由 agent 回复；登录靠扫码，无需 webhook 或付费 token。
howto.when: 当你要求接入个人微信、添加微信渠道，或想把微信消息接到 agent 时触发。

say.text: 帮我把个人微信接入 NanoClaw。
say.note: 开始执行安装和接入流程。

say.text: 添加微信渠道，并告诉我下一步该做什么。
say.note: 脚本会提示扫码登录并验证构建。

say.text: 把微信消息接到我指定的 agent 组。
say.note: 运行 wire-dm.ts 完成消息组绑定。

howto.what_en: After installation, NanoClaw can send and receive WeChat messages using your personal WeChat account: DMs and group chats are routed to an associated agent group and answered by the agent. Login is via QR scan; no webhook or paid token is needed.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you ask to integrate a personal WeChat account, add a WeChat channel, or route WeChat messages to an agent.

say_en.text: Connect my personal WeChat to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Starts the install and wiring flow.

say_en.text: Add the WeChat channel and tell me the next steps.
say_en.note: The script prompts for QR login and validation.

say_en.text: Route WeChat messages to my agent group.
say_en.note: Runs wire-dm.ts to bind the messaging group.
